breadcrumbs.name: Ntag215 NFC Stickers — 504-byte Amiibo-compatible NFC Tags, Wholesale

summary: NTAG215 NFC stickers provide 504 bytes of user memory — the exact chip used in Nintendo Amiibo figures and cards. This makes NTAG215 the essential chip for Amiibo cloning and game-related NFC projects, while also serving data-rich applications such as Wi-Fi sharing, detailed vCards, loyalty program tags and medium-length URL payloads. Available wholesale in rolls and sheets with optional NDEF pre-encoding.
